overview: The Akhevan Forward Camp is the first major organized Akhevan foothold inside Shadow Valley.
history: Akhevan scouts established the camp after securing Void-Scar Pass.
Praesertum agents arrived to oversee ritual operations.
Resonance pylons were erected to stabilize fractures near the camp.
Shadow conduits were built to channel corruption deeper into the valley.
The camp became the primary staging ground for Akhevan expansion.
hooks: A Praesertum agent demands assistance with a dangerous ritual.
A resonance pylon destabilizes and threatens the entire camp.
Akhevan tacticians prepare a major push into the Rift Basin.
